method.edits: Stage copies of the target speech 200 ms earlier and later in a local 700 ms window with 8 ms endpoint blends and unchanged PCM outside. Match only the independently labeled target in edited views.
method.neural: Unprompted CTC acoustic token emissions at a verified 20 ms hop. Keep the largest emission in each run of the same token if posterior is at least 0.35.
method.reference: Match independent publisher B or P intervals one-to-one on the native 16 kHz audio clock, with 40 ms interval padding. Maximize distinct matches, then minimize total absolute midpoint error.
method.sources: CC BY 4.0 Lombard frontal and audio archive members with published phone alignment labels. Choose four development and eight held speaker codes by fixed hash order. Each speaker supplies two plain and two Lombard utterances. Verify the full picture archive and the size, CRC and SHA-256 of selected audio members read from publisher byte ranges.
method.stable: Keep the original timestamp only if the same phone is observed within 40 ms after an independent 3.4 kHz low-pass delivery.
